metadata.description: ALPS (PRD) authoring, a business ontology above ADRs, and ADR-driven development for Claude Code, as three independent plugins.

plugins.name: alps-writer
plugins.description: Author ALPS (PRD) documents via an MCP server — guided, section-by-section product specs. Hand Section 7 features to the adr-writer plugin with /feature-to-adr.

plugins.name: adr-writer
plugins.description: ADR-driven development cycle: author ADRs with /adr-new, implement with /adr-impl, apply verified low-risk refactors before completion, and sync with /adr-sync, with an ADR-first hook that re-injects the ADR map every turn. Works standalone, no ALPS PRD required.

plugins.name: ontology-writer
plugins.description: Business ontology above ADRs as a closed RDFS-lite graph in Turtle: build it from documents with /ontology-build, change it through one approval summary with /ontology-edit, align realizing ADRs with /ontology-align, and open a read-only 3D view with /ontology-view. Pairs with adr-writer for changes that reach ADRs.
